title: SessionStart
description: Opens a session on a workspace. The path is checked against the allowlist before anything else happens — it is the first line of defence, not a hint.

x-required-when.because: a fork point is a message of a conversation, and only a resumed conversation has one

workspacePath.description: Absolute path of the workspace. Outside the allowlist it is refused with WORKSPACE_NOT_ALLOWED, and a root that exists but belongs to someone else answers 404, never 403.

model.description: Model to open with. Absent means the server default.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode to open with. Absent means the server default. `allowAll` is Permitir tudo, a mode of ours: the SDK runs in `default` and the server approves every tool nobody's rule refuses, except the ones that are questions (ADR-022). `bypassPermissions` is the SDK's, and is never honoured.

effort.description: How much effort the model puts in, for the whole session. Absent is the installation's default. Chosen before the session exists, because changing it on a live one (`applyFlagSettings`) restarts the CLI's query and drops its hooks — measured in plan 08, D-16. A level the model does not take is `INVALID_INPUT` (`session.error.effortUnsupported`). An enum read as a string, so a level added later does not break a client.

resumeSessionId.description: Session of the Agent SDK to resume instead of starting fresh.

forkAt.description: Edit and resend: the `messageId` of the user prompt to rewrite. The conversation `resumeSessionId` names continues from **just before** it, always in a new id — the original stays as it was (plan 08, D-19). A point the conversation does not have is `INVALID_INPUT` (`session.error.forkPointUnknown`); one the CLI refuses is `SESSION_FORK_REJECTED`.
